senses.definition: (informal) The opening sequence at beginning of a film, television program, etc.
(demoscene) A small demo produced to promote one's demogroup or for a competition.

quotes.text: If the rules specify that the DLLs' size will be added to the 64K limit, there's not a lot of space to code an intro.
quotes.reference: 1999, brainpower / digital artists, “Win32 demos”, in comp.sys.ibm.pc.demos (Usenet):

quotes.text: Are there any sites that have original copies of games? (ie: Summer/Winter/World Games with Fast Loading). Just looking for games without the trainers/intros.
quotes.reference: 2001, LJames4728, “Good C64 Game Sites?”, in alt.c64 (Usenet):

quotes.text: Games, demos, intros. They were the same, this was the scene. The trend was that you cracked and made demos and intros.
